data:
Decision: GO. Win probability 98.4%.

Top factors driving probability: (1) Strong expected evaluation score (~81/100) is the dominant positive driver. (2) Very limited compliance issues—only 1 gap and 6 partials across 29 checks (86.2% compliant)—supports a low-risk bid posture. (3) Bid size is not a material headwind (budget impact is slightly negative but negligible), and the tender package is manageable (short document) with adequate response time (96 hrs; minor negative impact only).

Mandatory gaps and what closing them takes: None identified in the current compliance assessment (mandatory_gaps = []). Focus should be on converting the 6 “PARTIAL” items to “PASS” and clearing the single non-mandatory gap via targeted clarifications, document completions, and evidence packs (OEM authorizations, past performance, QA/HSE, and commissioning methodology as applicable).

Recommendation: Proceed to submission, prioritize closing partial compliances and strengthening the technical/QA narrative to protect the projected score.
